meta.name: BuzzFeed Celeb
meta.description:
From the latest celebrity headlines to favorite
hilariously mundane happenings, BuzzFeed is here to
keep you updated on what all your favorite celebs
are up to.

Shows: Sarah Paulson & Sydney Sweeney Play With Puppies, Billie Eilish & Sabrina Carpenter Talk Music & Fame, Hilary Duff & Ashley Tisdale Talk Disney Days, Idris Elba, John Cena & Madelyn Cline Take The Co-Star Test, Kevin Hart, Chris Pratt & Kevin Bacon Take Quizzes
Available on: Samsung TV Plus
